title: Whitebox missing enum/constants and rendering pattern sections for late-phase features
description: Phase 4 includes PA-4/PA-5 (entity management with CommType bitmask) and AI-4 (NER producing entity zones). Section 3.7 (Enums and Constants) provides canonical PositionType enum values and bitmask constants. Section 1.4 (Zone-Based Content Rendering) describes NER entity zone integration. Both missing from Phase 4 whitebox.
root_cause: Same underlying issue: coarse domain matching misses cross-cutting reference sections. Phase 4's NER and entity management features reference enums and rendering patterns from sections not directly tied to the AI or Policy Admin domains.
recommendation: Same fix: feature-level requirement scan. Also consider always including Section 3.7 (Enums/Constants) in every phase that has features referencing typed enums or bitmask columns.
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Whitebox Reference Sections
